name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
description: Financial assistance for eligible students from Scheduled Caste communities pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary studies.
benefits: May include maintenance allowance and approved compulsory non-refundable fees, subject to current scheme rules.

eligibility.label: Belong to a Scheduled Caste community
Annual family income is within the published limit
Enrolled in a post-matriculation or post-secondary course

documents: Aadhaar or other permitted identity proof
steps: Check the current state and central scheme guidelines.
Register or sign in on the National Scholarship Portal when applications are open.
Complete the application and upload the requested documents.
Submit the application to your institution for verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to exclusions and current government rules.
benefits: Eligible families may receive ₹6,000 per year in three installments, subject to scheme rules.

eligibility.label: Farmer family with eligible cultivable landholding

documents: Land ownership or land record details
steps: Review current eligibility rules and exclusions on the official portal.
Use the portal's Farmers Corner or contact your local agriculture office.
Complete registration with land and bank details.
Check status through the official portal.
verified: Check the portal for current rules

Household meets the applicable home ownership and income criteria

name: Stand-Up India
authority: Department of Financial Services, Government of India
description: Facilitates bank loans for eligible SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite bank loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore may be available under current scheme terms.

eligibility.label: Borrower is a woman or belongs to SC/ST category
Proposal is for a greenfield enterprise
Eligible ownership stake in a non-individual enterprise

documents: Business registration and financial documents as requested by bank
steps: Review current scheme details and eligibility.
Prepare a business plan and required documents.
Apply through an eligible bank branch or official portal.
Work with the bank on appraisal and loan terms.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
authority: Department of Higher Education, Government of India
description: Scholarship support for meritorious students from families below the scheme's income ceiling who pursue higher education.
benefits: Scholarship amount and continuation rules depend on course level and current guidelines.

eligibility.label: Performance in Class XII meets the published board-specific cut-off
Family income is within the published ceiling
Not receiving another incompatible scholarship or benefit

steps: Check the current scheme notification and eligibility cut-offs.
Apply through the National Scholarship Portal during the application window.
Enter academic, income, and bank details accurately.
Submit for institution and authority verification.
